name: Adithya Institute of Iyengar Yoga
description: Iyengar yoga school in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru, taught by Narayan Sir, a direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar who has taught since 1989. A slow, precise practice with props, steady breath and no strain.

teacher.name: Narayan Sir
teacher.description: A direct student of B.K.S. Iyengar, teaching Iyengar yoga since 1989, and in Vijayanagar, Bengaluru since 2002. He speaks Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, English and Hindi.
